user.title: Set up Smart Place
user.description: Paste the long secret URL token from your Smart Place app URL. The token is everything after `?` in `https://spr1.smartplace.ch:8770/Start5?<token>`.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Smart Place
reauth_confirm.description: Your Smart Place token has been rejected. Paste a fresh token from the app URL.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected by Smart Place.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Smart Place server. Check connectivity and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Smart Place installation is already configured.
